title: Stroke Recovery and Rehabilitation
details: Recovery depends on the area of the brain affected and the amount of damage.
Speech Therapy: Helps with speaking, understanding, reading, writing and swallowing.
Physical Therapy: Helps relearn movement and coordination.
Occupational Therapy: Helps improve daily activities like eating, drinking, dressing, bathing, reading, and writing.
Psychological Support: Vital for dealing with depression or emotional changes.
